V3.1 uses UTF-16 filename units, per-archive key derived from 256 bytes at EOF-0x41c, variable-name index entries
Old C models high offset DWORD as unknown while Python/Rust read u64; real fourth-game layout still not_tested
Compressed hash path frees hash_data which points inside pack_hash allocation; unsafe to run directly on arbitrary inputs
V3.1 payload methods 1 and >1 use distinct decryptors; method2 needs suitable key material; extraction success is not established locally
20-byte canvas header and 28-byte tile descriptor precede embedded images
RGBA canvas with per-tile paste; overlaps replace prior pixels; original-engine blending agreement not_tested
Format detector requires one line equal two different strings with &&, making its success condition unreachable
Parser classifies includes, labels, line tags, backslash commands, names, sound markers, text; not an execution engine
Extractor handles name-to-next-text association, [n], select and savetext; does not implement branch evaluation or effect semantics
UTF16 read loop does not reject a one-byte partial read explicitly; malformed-input behavior requires runtime regression test
Prefix-based ignore/text filters target localization, not full execution semantics or fourth-game proof
